projects.name: JSON Contract Inspector
projects.purpose: Inspect a JSON value and report its top-level fields and primitive value types.
projects.inputs: A JSON value entered in the browser starter.
projects.outputs: A JSON report of validJson and top-level field types.
projects.constraints: Dependency-free, local-only, never execute input, and treat names as data.
projects.instructions: Parse the input and report its top-level shape; return a readable parse error for invalid JSON.
projects.acceptance: Valid objects report field types; arrays and primitives report their shape; malformed JSON reports validJson false; hostile text cannot inject markup.
projects.components: Generated app/index.html, app/README.md, and the versioned FoundRy backup envelope.
projects.evidence: Smoke checker exercises valid, invalid, and hostile JSON in a real browser runtime.
